vars.prTitle: UserSessionUtil.findValidSession: report missing/expired session via null
vars.prBody: findValidSession threw an invalid_token WebApplicationException when the session was missing or expired, which makes it awkward to use from code that just wants to check for a session (e.g. admin permission evaluation for lightweight tokens already null-checks the result). The event error is still recorded; the method now returns null in those two cases and documents it. Stale-token and transient-user failures keep throwing.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "UserSessionUtil.findValidSession now returns null for a missing or expired session instead of throwing error.invalidToken(...). Existing callers rely on the throw: UserInfoEndpoint.issueUserInfo (services/.../oidc/endpoints/UserInfoEndpoint.java:232) immediately dereferences userSession.getUser(), so a userinfo call with a token whose session was logged out/expired now fails with a NullPointerException (HTTP 500) instead of 401 invalid_token. TokenManager.getValidUserSessionIfTokenIsValid (TokenManager.java:298-305) only catches exceptions around the call and then calls userSession.getUser() outside the try, so token introspection of such tokens throws an NPE instead of returning active=false. Only MgmtPermissions handles null.", "severity": "High"}]
